budget_policy.atomic_scope: prior + UNP question rewrite + Teacher + evaluation question rewrite
budget_policy.evaluation_finalization: one complete 900-task outcome set; permanently close only this purpose
budget_policy.ordinary_transport_unknown: hold full lease, no retry of that task
budget_policy.registry: original selected dev/confirm task identity and complete public-spec SHA
budget_policy.settlement_after_study_stop: allowed for already sent requests; never discard actual cost
budget_policy.successful_HTTP_unknown_billing: hold conservative debit and persist study_fatal

rule.consumer: separate evaluation purpose, three-purpose atomic common budget
rule.explicit_user_authorization: 900 tasks, two requests each, shared purpose cap accepted
rule.fallback: retain exact original template bytes and rejected response history
rule.model_input: public model_contract only; no private bundle or method labels
rule.original_source_audit: inherit exact passed parent; no 900-source reaudit
registered_semantic_domains: growth with positive previous denominator and percent units
arithmetic mean of exactly three specified actual periods
primary maximum across full window then same-period secondary metric
rule.selection: first semantic-valid candidate ends selection; then classify wording change
rule.source_order: original selected panel catalog order, dev then confirm
rule.unchanged_fields: TaskID, sources, private reference, periods, units and operation contract
rule.unchanged_rule: keep exact original public bytes; no second candidate or repair to boost rate
rule.unrequested_after_fatal: template retained, explicitly not requested; no completion claim
rule.validation: saved rewritten base itself, then exact restored public contract

transport_policy.input_bound: complete serialized UTF8 request body plus fixed overhead
transport_policy.model_inputs: fixed prompt and public protected model_contract only; no whole spec or identity
